purpose: Lift the N=1 prime-field phase coboundary obstruction through derived quotients to rule out rhoE-source promotion for finite solvable matrix carriers whose abelian composition primes lie in the certified set {2,3,5,7}.

certified_scope.carrier_class: finite solvable carriers whose abelian composition factors have prime orders only in the certified set
certified_scope.not_claimed: No obstruction is claimed for perfect or non-solvable finite carriers, larger meshes, typed Cech/monad data, or D_E-response promotion.

derived_series_lift.lemma: If a finite solvable carrier G admitted a non-coboundary N=1 source-level flat table, then after descending to the first nontrivial derived quotient one obtains a non-coboundary abelian prime-order phase table. The certified zero-H1 phase result forbids this for primes 2,3,5,7.

verdict.next_step: Either test a perfect/non-solvable carrier such as A5 or PSL(2,7), move the finite search to N>1, or construct selected D_E/dotD response data that passes de_response promotion.
